label: Plant code
definition: Code of the treatment plant, as in the spatial points dataflow. Primary key. Its identifier scheme is always `euUWWTPCode`, the only one used, so the scheme is not reported.
condition: Accepted code of a treatment plant of the country in {ref}`sp-uwwtp`

label: Status
definition: Status of the plant at the reference year.

label: Expected load
definition: Planned load entering the plant at the expected date of compliance.

label: Expected capacity
definition: Planned organic design capacity of the plant.

label: Remarks
definition: Any relevant comment on the plant.
